package v1

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/api/v1/handlers"
)

func TestStudentRoutesAreRegisteredWithExplicitRolePolicy(t *testing.T) {
	router := NewRouter(&handlers.PersonalTeacherHandler{}, &handlers.TeacherDialogHandler{}, &handlers.CurriculumHandler{}, &handlers.LearningSessionHandler{}, &handlers.TelegramChannelHandler{}, &handlers.TeacherOnboardingHandler{}, &handlers.NextBestActionHandler{})
	for _, route := range []struct {
		method string
		path   string
	}{
		{method: http.MethodGet, path: "/teacher/me"},
		{method: http.MethodPatch, path: "/teacher/me"},
		{method: http.MethodGet, path: "/teacher/me/soul"},
		{method: http.MethodPatch, path: "/teacher/me/soul"},
		{method: http.MethodPut, path: "/teacher-dialog/ensure"},
		{method: http.MethodPost, path: "/teacher/me/learning-path/plan"},
		{method: http.MethodPost, path: "/teacher/me/learning-sessions/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/summarize"},
		{method: http.MethodPost, path: "/teacher/me/channels/telegram/link-code"},
		{method: http.MethodPost, path: "/teacher/me/onboarding/ensure"},
		{method: http.MethodPost, path: "/teacher/me/assistant-ui/actions"},
		{method: http.MethodGet, path: "/teacher/me/next-action"},
	} {
		response := httptest.NewRecorder()
		request := httptest.NewRequest(route.method, route.path, nil)
		router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
		require.Equal(t, http.StatusUnauthorized, response.Code)
	}
}
